title: Measurement + model comparison
description: Set the reduced measurement against a declared model run, merge them so disagreements surface as collisions, and loop on assumptions until they reconcile.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: wf-astro-02
  title: Measurement + model comparison
  description: Set the reduced measurement against a declared model run, merge them so disagreements surface
    as collisions, and loop on assumptions until they reconcile.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Publish a measurement whose agreement with the physical model was tested explicitly, with
    uncertainty propagated and systematics named rather than absorbed.
  policies:
    maxConcurrency: 4
    onFailure: preserve-completed
    requireApprovalFor:
      - n-approval
  nodes:
    - id: n-intake
      kind: input
      name: Reduced observations and model inputs
      summary: Reduced observations and model inputs
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - text
        properties:
          text:
            type: string
            description: The requester's objective, source material, or instructions.
          workflowFields:
            type: object
            required:
              - calibrated_measurements
              - instrument_response
              - model_parameters
              - uncertainty_budget
            properties:
              calibrated_measurements: {}
              instrument_response: {}
              model_parameters: {}
              uncertainty_budget: {}
        x-ladder-input-mode: document
    - id: n-model
      kind: agent
      templateRef: astro-02
      name: Reduction and measurement interpretation
      summary: Model-side estimate with stated assumptions.
      role: Analyst reducing raw observations into calibrated, uncertainty-carrying measurements.
      prompt: You are an Astrophysical Data Reduction Analyst. You apply calibration, background subtraction,
        and systematic corrections with each step and its version recorded, and you propagate uncertainty
        rather than reporting a central value alone. You distinguish an instrumental artifact from a source
        signal before anyone builds a claim on it, and you say when the reduction cannot separate the
        two.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - domain-analysis
          - statistical-analysis
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        connectors:
          - mcp:archive
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-run
      kind: tool
      name: Physical model run
      summary: Host-supplied forward model or simulation of the observed system. Declared as a requirement;
        Ladder Graph does not execute it and no simulated value may be reported as measured.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - domain-analysis
          - evaluation
        tools:
          - calculate
          - mcp:archive
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-compare
      kind: aggregator
      name: Merge estimate and instrument run
      summary: Merge the two result objects; every field where they disagree is surfaced as a collision
        rather than silently overwritten.
      config:
        aggregation: merge
    - id: n-fit
      kind: evaluate
      inlineRole: true
      name: Score agreement
      summary: Evaluate agreement between measurement and model within the propagated uncertainty budget.
      role: Deterministic metric evaluator
      prompt: Evaluate the upstream result against agreement between measurement and model within the
        propagated uncertainty budget. Return a score, pass/fail verdict, the evidence behind the verdict,
        remaining uncertainty, and the smallest corrective action. Do not claim programmatic measurement
        unless the host supplies the required tool.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - evaluation
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - score
          - passed
          - reasons
        properties:
          score:
            type: number
          passed:
            type: boolean
          reasons:
            type: array
            items:
              type: string
      config:
        threshold: 0.8
    - id: n-converged
      kind: condition
      name: Converged?
      summary: Route on fit.passed.
      config:
        expression: fit.passed
        branches:
          - label: Converged
            when: 'true'
          - label: Refine
            when: 'false'
    - id: n-refine
      kind: loop
      name: Refine assumptions until agreement
      summary: Repeat a bounded revision sequence until agreement between the estimate and the instrument
        run meets the declared threshold.
      config:
        body:
          - n-model
          - n-run
          - n-compare
          - n-fit
          - n-converged
        exitCondition: agreement between the estimate and the instrument run meets the declared threshold
        maxIterations: 4
        onExhausted: stop
    - id: n-approval
      kind: approval
      name: Principal investigator approves the result for publication drafting
      summary: Pause for the principal investigator; on timeout, escalate.
    - id: workflow-output
      kind: output
      name: Released deliverable
      summary: Return the completed Measurement + model comparison deliverable, the evidence behind it,
        and every unresolved item.
  edges:
    - id: wf-astro-02-edge-1
      from: n-intake
      to: n-model
      kind: data
    - id: wf-astro-02-edge-2
      from: n-intake
      to: n-run
      kind: data
    - id: wf-astro-02-edge-3
      from: n-model
      to: n-compare
      kind: data
    - id: wf-astro-02-edge-4
      from: n-run
      to: n-compare
      kind: data
    - id: wf-astro-02-edge-5
      from: n-compare
      to: n-fit
      kind: data
    - id: wf-astro-02-edge-6
      from: n-fit
      to: n-converged
      kind: data
    - id: wf-astro-02-edge-7
      from: n-converged
      to: n-approval
      kind: control
      condition: 'true'
    - id: wf-astro-02-edge-8
      from: n-converged
      to: n-refine
      kind: control
      condition: 'false'
    - id: wf-astro-02-edge-9
      from: n-refine
      to: n-approval
      kind: control
      condition: loop_exit
    - id: wf-astro-02-edge-10
      from: n-approval
      to: workflow-output
      kind: dependency
      condition: approved
